Powerful heat that fits everywhere: Dreo space heaters for indoor combines Hyperamics 1500W advanced PTC system with a new heat funnel design to deliver heat within seconds and enhance warm air circulation for up to 200% farther reach than traditional heaters. Unbreakable safety: Dreo goes beyond the unexpected to deliver peace of mind with every room heater. Fits into your lifestyle: This portable heater handle makes it easier to carry and is equipped with multiple heating levels and modes to heat as you like (Power heat, ECO, Fan Only). It also features handy extras for a hassle-free experience (12-hour timer, mute, child lock, and memory function). Upgraded Control Panel: This new version features a silk-screened button design that stands out with a white-on-black background for enhanced visibility and better user experience. Yes Product description Product Description HG Mould Spray is a fast-acting black mould remover for walls and household surfaces affected by visible mould, mildew, fungus and algae in damp areas. Its targeted, self-acting spray has a bleaching action and works in around 30 minutes, helping remove stains without scrubbing on compatible surfaces. Use it indoors in bathrooms, showers, toilets, kitchens, cellars, basements and saunas on suitable plastered walls, tiles, grout, silicone joints, window frames and other compatible surfaces. It can also be used outdoors around compatible swimming pools, facades, balconies, plant boxes and garden ornaments, excluding wood. One 500ml bottle treats approximately 2–3 m² of wall surface or 6–8 m² of tile grout. Ensure good ventilation and wear suitable rubber or plastic gloves. Remove the safety clip or unlock the nozzle. Spray from approximately 3–5cm away and leave for 30 minutes. Clean the treated area with water and a sponge. For stubborn stains, reapply and leave for a further 30 minutes. For silicone joints, wash off after 30 minutes and repeat if necessary. Always test first in an inconspicuous area. Permanent brown discolouration may occur on elastic grouting, badly glazed tiles or old tiles with hairline cracks. Do not use on wood, coloured surfaces, ceilings, clothing, paintwork, plastic shower trays, vertical blinds, aluminium, stainless steel or other sensitive metals. Avoid splashes and do not reuse the bottle. Never mix with other cleaning products, as dangerous chlorine gas may be released. Wash hands after handling. Store and transport cool, dark and upright. Very toxic to aquatic life; avoid release into the environment. Keep out of reach of children and read the label before use. I picked up this Tapo L530B colour bulb not expecting much given the price, but it’s actually been a really solid addition and great value for money. Setup was straightforward through the Tapo app and linking it with Alexa only took a couple of minutes. Since then it’s been reliable with no dropouts, which is always my main concern with smart stuff. Brightness is more than enough for a main room light and it dims nicely through the app or voice control. Just worth knowing it won’t work with a traditional dimmer switch, so it’s better on a standard on/off. The colours are better than I expected as well great colour temperature range. The whites go from a warm cosy tone to a cooler brighter light, and the colours are strong enough to actually notice without looking cheap or washed out. In day to day use it’s very responsive. Commands through Alexa are pretty much instant and it reconnects quickly if it’s been turned off at the wall. Only small downside is the usual smart bulb thing where if someone turns it off at the switch, you lose control until it’s turned back on again, but that’s not really a fault with this one specifically. Overall, it just works. Easy to set up, reliable, and does exactly what you’d want from a smart bulb without spending a fortune. Compatible with Alexa and google home. The Atari app oddly takes up a lot of storage space if this is a premium for you but does work very well And easy to navigate. " Read more " Small and tears very easily " Read more View Image Gallery Amazon Customer 5.0 out of 5 stars Images in this review Reviews with images See all photos Previous slide Next slide All photos Amazon Customer 5 out of 5 stars Comfortable, True-to-Size Gloves That Don't Tear Easily I've tried quite a few disposable gloves over the years for various jobs, including DIY, maintenance work, and more 3D resin printing, and these have impressed me more than expected. Sizing is often an issue with disposable gloves, as many of the cheaper ones I've bought in the past tend to come up smaller than advertised. An XL can sometimes fit more like a Large. Thankfully, these are true to size. The XL fits me perfectly, with no tight spots and no excess material at the fingertips, making them comfortable to wear while still allowing good dexterity. The gloves strike a nice balance in thickness. They're not the thickest nitrile gloves I've used, but they're certainly not flimsy or paper-thin either. They provide a reassuring level of protection while still allowing enough finger sensitivity for detailed tasks. One thing I particularly like is how much stretch they have. They slide on easily and stretch well without immediately tearing, which is something I've experienced with cheaper gloves in the past. My main use for these has been 3D resin printing, where reliable hand protection is essential. During several printing sessions, I had no issues with resin penetrating the gloves, and they held up well while handling resin-coated parts. They gave me confidence that my hands were properly protected throughout the process. Being powder-free and latex-free is another plus, especially for anyone with latex sensitivities or who simply prefers gloves that don't leave residue behind. They're comfortable enough to wear for extended periods and don't have an overpowering chemical smell when first opened. Considering the fit, durability, comfort, and level of protection they provide, I think these offer excellent value for money. They perform exactly as I'd hoped and compare favourably with gloves that cost considerably more. Once this box is finished, I'll happily buy another. The biggest strength is the absorbency and odour control. The granules act like a sponge, locking in moisture quickly before smells develop, which really helps keep the litter tray fresh between full changes. It also uses a mineral protection system that reduces ammonia odours, so it doesn’t get unpleasant too quickly. Another thing I like is that it’s unscented and made from natural materials (quartz and limestone), so there’s no artificial fragrance masking smells just straightforward hygiene. A few downsides: It’s non-clumping, so you can’t just scoop out urine you’ll need to change the whole tray more regularly The granules can track a bit outside the tray Large 20L bag can be a bit heavy to handle Overall, it’s a dependable, hygienic litter that does exactly what it promises without overcomplicating things. Verdict: A great everyday cat litter with strong odour control and natural ingredients—ideal if you prefer non-clumping, low-maintenance options.
